shortTitle: ATS Weight Management in Adult OSA
fullTitle: The Role of Weight Management in the Treatment of Adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea
citation: Hudgel DW, Patel SR, Ahasic AM, et al. The role of weight management in the treatment of adult obstructive sleep apnea: an official American Thoracic Society clinical practice guideline. Am J Respir Crit Care Med. 2018;198(6):e70-e87.
currencyNote: The ATS continues to list this as its official adult OSA weight-management clinical practice guideline. Newer obesity-treatment options and OSA-specific medication indications require current labeling and current clinical-resource review.
bestFor: Structured adult OSA weight-management concepts, lifestyle support, and the role of weight management as part of comprehensive OSA care.

mappingRationale.D4B: Supports weight-management pathways as an alternative/adjunctive OSA treatment concept without replacing AASM treatment/referral guidance.

authorityBoundary: Current specialty support, not a governing AASM authority in the Guild hierarchy. Use current AASM guidance for OSA treatment/referral when applicable. Medication eligibility/prescribing belongs to the treating clinician and current FDA labeling; technologists should not infer or teach an independent prescribing algorithm.
copyrightUse: Use citation, public guideline scope, original summaries, and learning objectives only. Do not reproduce recommendation text, evidence tables, algorithms, or substantial protected prose.

sections.label: Weight management as part of adult OSA treatment
